ratings.reviewer_notes: Broad review of ferroptosis across liver diseases that includes liver fibrosis and therapeutic targeting, but provides review-level rather than primary evidence.
Directly shows that celastrol induces ferroptosis in activated HSCs through PRDX and HO-1-associated ROS regulation, with an antifibrotic effect.
Provides cell and CCl4-model evidence that exosomal miR-26a targets SLC7A11, induces HSC ferroptosis, suppresses HSC activation, and attenuates fibrosis.
Demonstrates that TRIM26 promotes SLC7A11 ubiquitination and HSC ferroptosis and mitigates CCl4-induced liver fibrosis in mice.
Directly links suppression of HSC ferroptosis by the MafG/MYH9-LCN2 axis to fibrosis and shows that erastin-induced HSC ferroptosis alleviates BDL-induced fibrosis.

Mechanistically links curcumol-induced HSC ferroptosis and senescence to the HIF-1alpha-NCOA4-FTH1 axis as a proposed antifibrotic mechanism, although fibrosis outcome data are not detailed in the abstract.
Shows that dihydroartemisinin alleviates hepatic fibrosis by inducing NCOA4/autophagy-associated ferroptosis in activated HSCs, with ferroptosis inhibitors impairing the effect.
Provides mechanistic, murine, and human-tissue evidence connecting m6A-BECN1-autophagy signaling, HSC ferroptosis, and alleviation of liver fibrosis.
Directly demonstrates that carvedilol induces HSC ferroptosis through the ER stress/ATF4/SAT1/spermidine axis and ameliorates CCl4-induced fibrosis.
Focused review summarizing mechanisms and agents that induce HSC ferroptosis as an experimental treatment for liver fibrosis.
Shows that ELAVL1-driven BECN1/autophagy signaling promotes HSC ferroptosis and is required for sorafenib-mediated fibrosis alleviation, with supporting murine and human HSC findings.
Direct evidence that iron-associated ferroptosis can increase HSC fibrogenic signaling and fibrosis markers, linking ferroptosis to progression rather than resolution of fibrosis.
Directly proposes that curcumol reduces extracellular matrix deposition by inducing NCOA4/FTH1-associated ferritinophagy and ferroptosis in activated HSCs.
Demonstrates that ellagic acid disrupts VAMP2-dependent SNARE complexes and ferroportin trafficking, causing HSC ferroptosis and reducing fibrosis in CCl4-treated mice.
Shows in TAA and CCl4 models that berberine induces ROS- and ferrous redox-mediated HSC ferroptosis; ferrostatin-1 diminishes its antifibrotic effect.
Provides in vivo and HSC evidence that decursin facilitates ferroptosis and reduces CCl4-induced fibrosis, with ferroptosis inhibition disrupting the antifibrotic effect.
Shows that daphnetin promotes GPX4 ubiquitination and ferritinophagy-mediated HSC ferroptosis, reducing CCl4-induced fibrosis; ferroptosis blockade reverses the benefit.
Focused review describing pathways and prior studies connecting ferroptosis with liver fibrosis, but it is not primary experimental evidence.
Directly demonstrates that magnesium isoglycyrrhizinate induces HO-1-mediated HSC ferroptosis and ameliorates CCl4-induced fibrosis; ferroptosis inhibition abolishes the effect.
